title: 退款订单去重
query: 只查询 ecommerce_ops：对2026年8月1日至22日下单且实付金额大于0的订单，统计其中有退款记录的去重订单数、全部符合条件的订单数，以及前者除以后者的比例，保留4位小数；退款记录不限制申请时间和状态。
reason: 结果数值和维度匹配（忽略别名、列顺序、行顺序）

result.sql: WITH eligible_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id FROM orders o WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23 00:00:00' AND o.paid_amount > 0), refund_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT r.order_id FROM refunds r INNER JOIN eligible_orders e ON r.order_id = e.order_id) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refund_orders) AS "有退款订单数", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible_orders) AS "全部订单数", ROUND(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible_orders) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refund_orders) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible_orders) END, 4) AS "退款比例"
result.analysis: 2026年8月1日至8月22日下单且实付金额大于0的订单共398单，其中有退款记录的去重订单为56单，退款比例为0.1407。
